utterances.speaker: crew
utterances.text: Welcome to Sandbox Burger, what can I get for you today?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Can I get a Big Sandbox, a large fries, and a chocolate shake?

utterances.speaker: crew
utterances.text: Sorry, we're out of shakes right now. Would you like to make the Big Sandbox a meal?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No, not the meal. Just the burger and fries. And a medium sweet tea.

utterances.speaker: crew
utterances.text: Big Sandbox, large fries and a medium sweet tea. Your total is $11.27. Please pull around.
